title: Started MSc in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Surrey
description: Began an MSc in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Surrey, UK, focusing on machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision.

title: AlphaBorno at BLP-2025 Task 2 published
description: First-author paper on Bangla code generation with structured prompts and execution feedback, published at the Second Workshop on Bangla Language Processing (BLP-2025) in Mumbai, India. Our best system reached a Pass@1 of 72.2%.

title: SOMAJGYAAN published in Findings of IJCNLP-AACL 2025
description: A Bangla multiple-choice benchmark of 4,234 questions, built from Bangladeshi curriculum and social studies textbooks, for evaluating how well LLMs handle culturally grounded knowledge. Published in Findings of IJCNLP-AACL 2025, Mumbai, India.

title: Team BD placed 5th of 44 at the BEA 2025 Shared Task
description: Our MPNet ensemble placed 5th of 44 teams on Track 1 (Mistake Identification) and 7th of 31 on Track 2 (Mistake Location) in the shared task on pedagogical ability assessment of AI tutors, held at the BEA 2025 workshop in Vienna, Austria.

title: PACE study published at CHI 2025
description: Our study on improving user engagement and learning outcomes in PACE, an LLM-based Python tutor, appeared in the Extended Abstracts of CHI 2025 in Yokohama, Japan.

title: Conducted a 3-day hands-on workshop on LLMs
description: Ran a workshop on large language models covering data preparation, fine-tuning, and deployment, with demonstrations of LLaMA using llama.cpp.

title: Graduated with a BSc in Computer Science and Engineering
description: Completed my BSc in Computer Science and Engineering at Independent University, Bangladesh (IUB).

title: Joined CCDS as a Research Intern
description: Started as a Research Intern at the Center for Computational & Data Sciences (CCDS), IUB, working on dataset development and LLM-based educational systems.

title: Undergraduate thesis on PACE published
description: Our thesis, PACE: Python AI Companion for Enhanced Engagement, is now available in the IUB Academic Repository.

title: Attended the ACM SIGCHI Winter School, South Asia
description: Took part in a three-day Human-Computer Interaction winter school in Colombo, Sri Lanka, supported by a $500 travel grant.

title: Design Team, IEEEXtreme 17.0
description: Served on the Design Team for IEEEXtreme 17.0, IEEE's global 24-hour programming competition for student teams, held on 28 October 2023.

title: Fruit quality detection paper at IEEE ICCSCE 2023
description: Co-authored a paper on a fruit quality detection and monitoring system, published at the 13th IEEE International Conference on Control System, Computing and Engineering (ICCSCE 2023) in Penang, Malaysia.

title: Joined the IEEEXtreme 16.0 Design Team
description: Worked on PR graphics design for IEEEXtreme 16.0, IEEE's global 24-hour programming competition for student teams, held on 22 October 2022.

title: Became Chair of the IEEE Computer Society IUB Student Branch Chapter
description: Led the chapter until May 2023, growing active membership from 20 to 304 and the executive board from 7 to 17 members.

title: Founded Neumentora
description: Started Neumentora, a platform offering mentorship, technical resources, and community support for students and professionals in technology.
